title: the tools i actually pay for
description: These are the tools I'm paying for. Railway to host all the apps. CRM, the course platform, and then also we have the content automation. So all of that I'm paying $20 a month on Railway. So then I have TidyCal for calendar booking, Obsidian as the second brain, Cmux as managing agents, Granola and Fathom for sales calls, Cider for writing assistant, CapCut for basic video editing, SuperWhisper for voice to text, Spark for multiple email managing, TickTick for task and project management, Chrome browser, Mac computer, Super Whisper for voice to text, Spark for email. Highly recommend.
